name: Doori Kiss
source: From her birth she has been hospitalized for a long time. She is familiar with electricity, machinery and the like. Has an noisy hobby of creating railguns. Much of her knowledge is rather useless for everyday life however. She does not handle erotic talk well and will usually turn red and stiffen. She get’s especially flustered if it’s directed towards her.
